findings.title: Current worker progress displays the previous attempt report
findings.fact: Two actual owned supervised Git attempts for one task: old worker report/candidate capture/observed exit, public repair and fresh admission. Before the new worker reports, workers[].attempt.id is fresh but reported_progress principal/text belongs to the old exited worker.
